notes: Hover list: an item you just read in full isn't asked for again in that room and channel, even when the seller's name reads differently on the next pass. When the game window runs past the bottom of your screen, the watcher now says that's why the lower rows' popups can't be read.

history.notes: Zenith: a new "world" setting in config.json. Put "world": "Zenith" when you scan Zenith and your listings go to Zenith's prices only, never mixed with Windia's. Windia stays the default.
Zenith: a new "world" setting in config.json. Put "world": "Zenith" when you scan Zenith and your listings go to Zenith's prices only, never mixed with Windia's. Windia stays the default.

Shop names: a long name the shop cuts short ("Two-handed Sword A..", "Black Knucklevest P..") is no longer read as the shorter item it starts with. It goes to the scroll or item it really is, or is left unnamed when it could be several.

Trade chat: "Composite Bow 60 att" is the bow with 60 attack, not a 60% bow scroll; "wg", "wlr" and "pe" are read; a one-word item inside a longer name ("Red Beret", "Cupid's Crossbow") is no longer read as the short item; "4 str above average" is a roll grade, not 4 STR.
Shops selling Return Scroll - Nearest Town, Return Scroll to My Home and the new Return Scroll to Forgotten Hollow now read with the full item name instead of a cut-off one.

Once an hour, under your scan stats, the watcher shows your Club FM credits: this week's total, what you've earned and how far you are from unlocking pay. New scanners see it an hour after they start.

An equip popup read without its upgrades line is dropped: the bottom of the popup was hidden under the chat box or past the window, and stats above it could be missing too. The watcher tells you once every 30 minutes to move the shop window up or shrink the chat box.

A popup that runs past the bottom of the game window is no longer read: its lower stat lines are off screen, and the top half read as if it were the whole item. The watcher tells you once every 30 minutes to move the shop window up. Hovers over cash items, potions and stars are no longer counted as missed reads.

Item popups: read from the game's own pixels at any window size, look again at more contrasts when unsure, use the hovered item's base stats, and keep a stat one read missed. 213 of 216 test popups exact, 0 wrong.

Item popups: a stat the two reads disagree on is left out instead of guessed, plus signs read as 4 fixed, MaxMP no longer also read as MaxHP. Trade chat: item megaphones with only a price after S>, autowin prices after c/o, $> as sell, full scroll names
Trade chat names with a capital I or small l show the everyday spelling instead of being held back.
Trade chat names: the watcher now learns the chat font letter by letter, so seller names get read exactly as more of the font is learned. Until a name can be read that way it stays marked unsure.

Trade chat: megaphone posts in yellow and teal now read, sell posts reach Club FM within seconds, seller names are double checked and marked when unsure, and stats written in the post (8 DEX, +2 crit) come with it.

Shops outside the Free Market now show the map they're on (Perion Street Corner, Henesys Hunting Ground I), and the Free Market room reads even when the minimap is moved, dimmed or cut off at the edge.

Exact reading at every window size, not just 1920 and 3840. Seller names with touching letters read right. Hovering after you scroll a shop now matches the right item. Unsure rows are left out instead of guessed.
Reads shops exactly at 3840 x 2160: new letter shapes (Ky, zyz, tty) and a stray mark after an item name is ignored
Listing counts only count fully read listings; shops at other window sizes are kept on this PC to teach the reader that size
Seller names read right in game windows bigger than 1920 x 1080
Popups that name another item are never put on a row; a 0 price is never sent
Talks to Club FM at api.maplefm.gg
